headline: Abrego Garcia leaves US for Spain, ending deportation fight
pages: Kilmar Abrego Garcia, whose 2025 deportation to a prison in El Salvador became a flashpoint in President Donald Trump's immigration crackdown, left the United States for Spain on Tuesday. He flew on a commercial flight. His lawyer said the move is temporary and that he hopes to return to the US eventually. The government admitted it wrongly sent him to El Salvador. He was later brought back to face human trafficking charges, which were dropped. The administration then tried to deport him to other countries, including Uganda and Ghana. Video shared with CBS showed an ICE ankle monitor being removed on his arrival in Spain. He said he left happy and with his freedom.
Senator Chris Van Hollen of Maryland, who visited him in El Salvador, said he was now a free man in a country of his choice. Source: BBC News.
